title: Revit governed annotation types
test_intent: Determine whether applicable Revit annotation instances use governed annotation types and whether local duplicates or uncontrolled formatting variants have been introduced.

applicability.applies_when: The tested model or template contains text, dimensions, tags, symbols, keynotes, spot annotations, or other annotation classes covered by a governed annotation-type profile.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No governed annotation-type profile applies to the tested scope.

required_evidence: inventory of applicable annotation instances and type identities
observed type properties and parameter dependencies
approved exception or deviation records where applicable

result_logic.pass: Applicable annotations use approved governed types or approved exceptions and their governed properties/dependencies match the applicable profile without uncontrolled local variants.
result_logic.fail: An applicable annotation uses an unapproved duplicate/local type or deviates from an available governed profile without approved exception.
result_logic.not_applicable: No governed annotation-type profile applies to the tested scope.
result_logic.indeterminate: The required annotation-type catalogue/profile or expected properties are unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Derived from Appendix E annotation governance. Exact fonts, sizes, family names and dimension values remain configuration data until approved.
